prompt: Add one sphere at the origin with an exposed radius from 1 to 10, initially 3.
acceptance: One sphere; radius change doubles its bounding diameter.

prompt: Make a sphere centered at editable X, Y, Z coordinates.
acceptance: Moving X translates its center without changing diameter.

prompt: Make a box with independent width, depth and height controls.
acceptance: Three dimensions match inputs and vary independently.

prompt: Create a cylinder with adjustable radius and height.
acceptance: Circular section diameter is twice radius; height matches control.

prompt: Make a cone with radius and height controls.
acceptance: One apex; base radius and axial height match inputs.

prompt: Create a torus with independent major and minor radii.
acceptance: Closed ring; increasing minor radius thickens the tube.

prompt: Make an ellipsoid with three independent semi-axes.
acceptance: Bounds equal twice each semi-axis.

prompt: Make a capsule with straight length and end radius controls.
acceptance: Rounded ends; total length equals straight length plus two radii.

prompt: Create a hollow pipe with inner radius, outer radius and length.
acceptance: Through-hole remains open; inner radius stays below outer radius.

prompt: Create a rounded box with independent corner radius.
acceptance: Outer bounds preserved; radius is clamped below half the shortest side.

prompt: Draw a line between two draggable points.
acceptance: Endpoints follow both controls; length is their Euclidean distance.

prompt: Draw a circle with editable center and radius.
acceptance: Closed planar curve; radius change preserves center.

prompt: Create a regular polygon with editable side count and circumradius.
acceptance: Integer count changes number of equal-length edges.

prompt: Create a three-point arc with draggable points.
acceptance: Arc passes through all three; collinearity reports an actionable error.

prompt: Make an ellipse with independent major and minor radii.
acceptance: Planar closed curve with correct axis lengths.

prompt: Build a helix with radius, pitch and number of turns.
acceptance: Total height equals pitch times turns.

prompt: Build a planar spiral with initial radius and growth per revolution.
acceptance: Radius grows by requested amount each revolution.

prompt: Create an interpolated curve through five editable points.
acceptance: Curve passes through each point within tolerance.

prompt: Offset a closed rectangle inward by a controlled distance.
acceptance: Inner dimensions shrink by twice the offset; invalid offsets rejected.

prompt: Divide a circle into N equal arc-length intervals.
acceptance: N unique points with uniform angular spacing; no duplicate seam point.

prompt: Translate an existing object with independent XYZ controls.
acceptance: Topology and size unchanged; bounds shift by requested vector.

prompt: Rotate a box about a selectable axis by a degree control.
acceptance: Zero degrees preserves geometry; 90 degrees swaps appropriate bounds.

prompt: Scale a sphere uniformly about its center.
acceptance: Center unchanged; radius multiplied by scale.

prompt: Mirror a shape across the YZ plane.
acceptance: X coordinates reverse sign; distances are preserved.

prompt: Orient a panel from XY onto an editable target plane.
acceptance: Panel normal agrees with target normal.

prompt: Array a sphere in a row with count and spacing controls.
acceptance: Exact count; adjacent centers separated by spacing.

prompt: Array cylinders on a circular ring with count and ring radius.
acceptance: Exact count; all centers lie at ring radius.

prompt: Build a two-dimensional rectangular array with rows, columns and spacing.
acceptance: Count equals rows times columns; independent spacing changes.

prompt: Twist a tower around its vertical axis by a total-angle control.
acceptance: Base rotation is zero; top rotation matches requested angle.

prompt: Taper a column from a base radius to an independent top radius.
acceptance: End sections match both radii without translation.

prompt: Build a surface through four draggable corner points.
acceptance: Surface corners match inputs and remain connected.

prompt: Loft three circles with independent radii and elevations.
acceptance: Cross-sections interpolate the circles in elevation order.

prompt: Extrude a closed rectangle by an editable height.
acceptance: Extrusion height tracks control; profile dimensions retained.

prompt: Revolve a profile around a vertical axis with an angle control.
acceptance: 360 degrees closes the seam; partial angle leaves boundaries.

prompt: Sweep a circular section along a curved rail.
acceptance: Tube follows the rail with controlled section radius.

prompt: Make a ruled surface between two editable lines.
acceptance: Both lines remain boundary edges.

prompt: Generate a sine-wave surface with amplitude, wavelength and resolution controls.
acceptance: Zero amplitude is planar; wavelength changes periodicity.

prompt: Generate a Perlin-noise surface with seed, amplitude, frequency and resolution inputs.
acceptance: Same seed repeats; zero amplitude planar; changed seed changes heights.

prompt: Create a saddle surface with curvature and width controls.
acceptance: Opposite-sign principal curvatures near center; zero curvature planar.

prompt: Create a dome with span and rise controls.
acceptance: Boundary spans requested width; apex rise matches control.

prompt: Populate a planar rectangle with N random points and a seed.
acceptance: Exact count; points inside boundary; seed reproducibility.

prompt: Populate spheres on a Perlin-noise surface; expose noise seed, amplitude, frequency, population count and sphere radius.
acceptance: Surface feeds population; exact sphere count; centers lie on surface; seed repeatable.

prompt: Distribute spheres evenly along a curve using a count control.
acceptance: Exact count and equal arc-length intervals.

prompt: Place oriented panels on a surface UV grid.
acceptance: Panel normals follow sampled surface normals.

prompt: Scatter points on a surface with a minimum separation.
acceptance: All pairwise distances exceed threshold or report infeasibility.

prompt: Create a hexagonal point grid clipped to a rectangular region.
acceptance: Staggered rows; all points inside boundary.

prompt: Arrange circles on a Fibonacci spiral with count and scale controls.
acceptance: Golden-angle progression; deterministic count and radii.

prompt: Vary sphere radii by distance to a draggable attractor.
acceptance: Closer centers receive larger radii within specified bounds.

prompt: Populate cubes inside a closed box with a random seed.
acceptance: Centers contained; count and reproducibility verified.

prompt: Place columns on a grid and vary heights using Perlin noise.
acceptance: Column count follows grid; noise changes heights, not positions.

prompt: Create a mesh sphere with separate U and V subdivision controls.
acceptance: Closed finite mesh; refinement increases face count.

prompt: Create a triangulated rectangular terrain from height samples.
acceptance: Boundary dimensions preserved; all faces triangular.

prompt: Displace mesh vertices along normals by a noise amplitude.
acceptance: Zero amplitude unchanged; connectivity preserved.

prompt: Subdivide a cube mesh twice with a smoothness control.
acceptance: Refinement increases face count and changes shape as specified.

prompt: Reduce a mesh to a target face count while preserving its outline.
acceptance: Face budget respected; boundary deviation measured.

prompt: Thicken an open mesh to a closed shell with thickness control.
acceptance: Closed manifold output; measured thickness follows input.

prompt: Extract boundary edges of an open mesh.
acceptance: Only naked edges returned; internal edges excluded.

prompt: Compute and display mesh face normals with adjustable vector length.
acceptance: One normal per face; magnitude matches control.

prompt: Create a geodesic dome with subdivision and cut-height controls.
acceptance: Triangular facets; vertices below cut excluded or trimmed.

prompt: Create a perforated panel mesh with hole radius and spacing controls.
acceptance: Through-holes preserved; no inverted or non-finite faces.

prompt: Subtract a cylinder from a box to make a through-hole.
acceptance: Closed solid; hole penetrates both faces.

prompt: Union two overlapping boxes into one solid.
acceptance: Single closed solid; overlapping volume counted once.

prompt: Intersect a sphere and a box.
acceptance: Output contained in both inputs; expected nonzero volume.

prompt: Fillet the vertical edges of a box with a radius control.
acceptance: Selected edges rounded; other edges retain intended geometry.

prompt: Shell a box with an open top and wall-thickness control.
acceptance: Top open; bottom and side thickness follow input.

prompt: Slice a solid into horizontal fabrication contours at a spacing control.
acceptance: Section elevations are equally spaced and intersect the solid.

prompt: Create a rectangular panel with a grid of screw holes and edge margin.
acceptance: Hole centers honor margin; no holes outside panel.

prompt: Create a tab-and-slot joint with material thickness and clearance controls.
acceptance: Slot width equals tab thickness plus clearance.

prompt: Create a finger joint along a board edge with editable finger count.
acceptance: Alternating fingers; complementary mating edge; count verified.

prompt: Make a waffle structure from intersecting X and Y ribs with material thickness.
acceptance: Rib spacing and half-depth slots permit geometric assembly.

prompt: Using Shelf_Clean3, expose shelf width without changing shelf depth.
acceptance: Width changes; depth remains constant; model solves.

prompt: Using Shelf_Clean3, expose shelf count as an integer control.
acceptance: Increasing count creates the corresponding additional shelf geometry.

prompt: Using Shelf_Clean3, change vertical shelf spacing independently.
acceptance: Adjacent shelf elevation difference tracks spacing.

prompt: Add one sphere beside Shelf_Clean3 without replacing the shelf.
acceptance: Shelf remains visible; exactly one added sphere appears.

prompt: Replace the displayed shelf with one radius-controlled sphere.
acceptance: Only the requested sphere is displayed; source upload preserved.

prompt: Add cylindrical feet to each corner of Shelf_Clean3.
acceptance: Four feet stay at footprint corners after width/depth changes.

prompt: Add a back panel that follows shelf width and height.
acceptance: Panel bounds update with overall shelf dimensions.

prompt: Add a center divider that follows shelf height and depth.
acceptance: Divider centered in X and remains fitted after edits.

prompt: Add an adjustable overhang to the top shelf only.
acceptance: Top footprint grows; other shelves retain their footprints.

prompt: Switch Shelf_Clean3 between five and six shelves and preserve the app controls.
acceptance: Geometry count changes; all intended bindings remain valid.

prompt: Add overall width, height and depth dimensions around Shelf_Clean3.
acceptance: Three readable annotations track geometric bounds after every edit.

prompt: Dimension the clear gap between each adjacent pair of shelves.
acceptance: One gap measurement per adjacent pair; values track spacing and thickness.

prompt: Add a radius dimension to a sphere.
acceptance: Displayed value equals radius rather than diameter; follows edits.

prompt: Add an angle dimension between two editable lines.
acceptance: Annotation tracks actual angle in degrees.

prompt: Add a curve-length label to a helix.
acceptance: Value agrees with measured length and changes with pitch.

prompt: Display the area of a rectangular panel with explicit units.
acceptance: Area equals width times height; squared units shown.

prompt: Display volume and center of mass of a closed solid.
acceptance: Known primitive analytic values match within tolerance.

prompt: Show a bounding box around the final geometry.
acceptance: All final vertices contained; box updates on every solve.

prompt: Color panels by their distance from a draggable point.
acceptance: Color order agrees with distances and updates on movement.

prompt: Warn when a shelf exceeds a user-specified maximum span.
acceptance: Warning threshold uses measured span; no unsupported structural certification.

prompt: Build a reusable superellipsoid component with XYZ radii and two exponent inputs.
acceptance: Named typed inputs; bounded exponents; closed finite output.

prompt: Build a reusable gyroid component with cell size, threshold and bounding box inputs.
acceptance: Periodic field; bounded output and controllable topology.

prompt: Build a catenary curve component from span, sag and resolution.
acceptance: Endpoints fixed; midpoint sag matches target.

prompt: Build a paraboloid surface component with focal length and aperture inputs.
acceptance: Sample heights satisfy the paraboloid equation.

prompt: Create a radial pavilion with bay count, roof radius and height controls.
acceptance: Exact bay count; roof and supports stay connected.

prompt: Create a staircase with total rise, run and step count.
acceptance: Riser equals rise/count; final elevation equals total rise.

prompt: Build a louver facade with count, pitch and sun-angle rotation controls.
acceptance: Exact count; blade orientation tracks angle without changing pitch.

prompt: Build a Voronoi partition inside a rectangle with point count and seed.
acceptance: Cells cover boundary without overlap; same seed repeats.

prompt: Ask for zero population count, then restore it to ten.
acceptance: Zero is handled deliberately; restore produces ten instances without stale geometry.

prompt: Ask for one million spheres on a noise surface.
acceptance: Resource limit is explained; bounded alternative is offered, not an unbounded solve.
